scope_note: Catalogue of the nine demo rules as implemented. Every entry is a project-defined reconciliation; no entry is asserted to implement a specific GRI, IFRS S1, IFRS S2 or SASB requirement.

applicability_conditions: Records are grouped by company_id, report_year, observation_year, metric_id, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
At least two records must remain in one group.
not_run_conditions: Fewer than two matching records are present.
Company, reporting period, observation period, metric, unit, scope or verified reporting boundary differs.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: A failed comparison is downgraded from Contradicted to NeedsReview; a passing comparison remains Supported.

basis.description: Detects differing values among otherwise comparable Scope 1 records in the demo corpus.
basis.config_basis: Project arithmetic consistency; not a conclusion of GRI non-compliance.

applicability_conditions: Total and both parts share company_id, report_year, observation_year, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
not_run_conditions: Any total or part record is absent.
The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview; no Contradicted conclusion is created.

basis.description: Reconciles the selected employee total with the selected male and female components without asserting that the categories are exhaustive in every disclosure context.

applicability_conditions: Total and both classifications share company_id, report_year, observation_year, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
not_run_conditions: Any required total or classification record is absent.
The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview; no Contradicted conclusion is created.

basis.description: Reconciles selected waste classifications using a demo rounding tolerance; category completeness is not established.
basis.config_basis: Project reconciliation with a 0.02 tonne tolerance for displayed rounding.

applicability_conditions: Total and both treatment records share company_id, report_year, observation_year, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
not_run_conditions: Any required total or treatment record is absent.
The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview; no Contradicted conclusion is created.

basis.description: Reconciles the selected treatment amounts with the selected waste total in the demo dataset.

applicability_conditions: Records share company_id, metric_id, observation_year, unit and scope.
The group contains at least two distinct report_year values.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
not_run_conditions: Only one reporting year is available for the same observation year.
Company, metric, observation period, unit, scope or verified reporting boundary differs.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview; revisions can reflect restatement, method or boundary changes.

basis.description: Flags a changed value for the same observation year across reports for review; it does not characterize the revision as misconduct.

applicability_conditions: Part and total share company_id, report_year, observation_year, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
not_run_conditions: Either the board total or independent-member count is absent.
The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: A failed comparison is downgraded from Contradicted to NeedsReview; no legal minimum ratio is tested.

basis.description: Checks only that a disclosed subset count does not exceed its disclosed total.

applicability_conditions: All three records share company_id, report_year and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
The old intensity value is not zero.
not_run_conditions: Any old, new or stated-reduction record is absent.
The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.comparison: abs(((old - new) / old * 100) - stated_reduction) <= 0.5 percentage points
finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview.
special_cases: An old value of zero creates a NeedsReview finding without performing the percentage calculation.

basis.description: Recomputes the stated reduction from two intensity values in the same report.
basis.config_basis: Project arithmetic with a tolerance for a stated whole-percentage reduction.

applicability_conditions: Actual and target share company_id, report_year, observation_year, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
The configured direction is lower_is_better.
not_run_conditions: Either an actual or target variant is absent.
The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview; a target is not treated as an actual result.

basis.description: Compares an actual value with a same-period target using the direction recorded in project configuration.
basis.config_basis: Project target comparison; lower-is-better is stated in the extracted source configuration.

applicability_conditions: Both shares share company_id, report_year, observation_year, unit and scope.
A verified reporting boundary must match; unverified boundaries share the unresolved boundary bucket.
not_run_conditions: The records do not fall into the same comparison group.

finding_policy.unverified_boundary_effect: The configured failure status is already NeedsReview; the rule does not infer underlying headcounts.

basis.description: Checks whether the two selected displayed shares sum to 100 within the demo rounding tolerance.
basis.config_basis: Project arithmetic with a 0.1 percentage-point tolerance.
